note: Set A binds every drivetrain value to the correct component and property with supporting quotes and keeps the free-free-mode damping condition and the fully-deployed brake-torque condition; its only weakness is that each fact is duplicated under both the turbine and component entity, plus it omits the DOWEC 5,025,500 kg•m2 reference inertia. Set B has several clear misbindings and truncations: rated rotor speed given as 1173.7 rpm (that is the generator speed), drive-shaft spring/damping constants bound to the High-Speed Shaft, generator inertia bound to the High-Speed Shaft, generator efficiency bound to the Drivetrain (twice), and truncated values 867, 6, and 2. B also drops the fully-deployed condition on one brake-torque claim and has garbled quotes. A is clearly more faithful despite its redundancy.
